notes: This PRD covers Phase 1 (observation substrate) ONLY of the 4-phase CANON.md plan. ACTION FOR LATER: each subsequent phase must be spun up as its own feature-forge feature and run through the pipeline logically/in order — Phase 2 (execution-grammar clean break: run --detached, etc.) depends on Phase 1's monitor model; Phase 3 (contract & exit-code unification + events.ndjson formal versioning + review-signal fix) depends on Phases 1-2 and is the feature-forge-contract-breaking flip (bundle w/ minRunnerVersion bump, proposed v0.5.0); Phase 4 (web recovery actions + status vocabulary/badges + provider-agnostic agent templates) depends on Phase 1 substrate. Likely feature names: ux-overhaul-grammar (P2+P3 as one breaking flip) and ux-overhaul-web (P4). Ratified in this PRD session: clean-break monitor surface (remove loop watch/loop follow/--watch, NO aliases); cross-root discovery via central active-loop registry with stale-entry self-heal; events.ndjson resets per run (prior runs archived); state.json authoritative for status, events.ndjson authoritative stream/history with never-contradict invariant; best-effort hardened append (per-run seq, schemaVersion envelope from day one, torn-trailing-line reader tolerance); persist-all-events with token-update coalescing; web read-path included in Phase 1 (recovery buttons deferred to Phase 4); commit-rule fix across both templates + prompt-builder reminder (AGENT_ADDON rename stays with Part-B provider refactor). Dogfood with rauf-stable per forge.config.json. TECH-SPEC (v1) decisions ratified: D1 persist in LoopRunner.emitEvent() — runner owns per-run seq + token coalescing, core appendEvent owns the fs write, best-effort try/catch, single writer per root; D2 FLAT record = LoopEvent + seq + schemaVersion (PersistedEventSchema = LoopEventSchema ∩ {seq,schemaVersion}); seq is the DENSE persisted-record sequence (assigned only on write) so gaps mean corruption not coalescing; D3 token coalescing = time-based last-write-wins ≈1/sec (TOKEN_COALESCE_MS=1000, mirrors iteration-status throttle); D4 rotate events.ndjson → archive/{ts}-events.ndjson at runner.start() (reset.ts {ts}- pattern); D5 registry = per-loop entry files ~/.rauf/active/<sha256(stateDir)[:16]>.json, structurally concurrency-safe, reconcile-on-read against .loop.lock via NEW checkLockFile(lockPath) extracted from checkLock, self-heal/prune stale; D6 discovery scope = machine-wide (no scoping flag in P1); D7 cross-root listing = status --all; D8 web = backend parity (/loop/events tails events.ndjson, /api/loops reads registry) + NEW frontend <EventTimeline> consuming file-backed /loop/events (Scope B, bounded) — status label-map + missing badges (REVIEWING/PAUSED_USAGE_LIMIT/Needs Human) stay Phase 4 (event rendering ≠ status vocabulary, boundary holds); D9 follow = file-based primary (replay current-run events.ndjson then fs.watch-tail), server SSE optional latency opt, replay current-run ONLY. KEY IMPL LANDMINES: embedded-artifacts.ts (lines 42/364/423) carries the commit-rule bug and is the INSTALLED source — must regenerate via `pnpm --filter @rauf/core build` (runs generate-embedded-artifacts.ts), not just edit templates; add events.ndjson to RUNTIME_EXCLUDE_PATHSPECS in git-commit.ts; dev loop runs built dist/@rauf/loop (rebuild before testing). CONTRACT: Phase 1 is ADDITIVE — NO minRunnerVersion bump, NO feature-forge changes (those are Phase 3/v0.5.0). New core modules: events-log.ts, loop-registry.ts; new fs-utils helpers appendLine + readNdjson (torn-line tolerant). Web frontend has NO tests today — lean on backend tests for parity.
